description: This source file defines the Configuration class within the Aws\DefaultsMode namespace. It manages configuration settings for AWS SDK Default Modes, including validation, initialization, and accessors for configuration parameters.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: A class representing AWS SDK default configuration modes, capable of validating and loading mode-specific settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Configuration object, validating the mode, and loading configuration data from a JSON file if mode is not 'legacy'.

methods.name: getStsRegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns the STS regional endpoints setting.

methods.name: getS3UsEast1RegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns the S3 US East 1 regional endpoints setting.

methods.name: getConnectTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the connection timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: getHttpRequestTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings as an associative array.
